data.name: Home_Intro
data.value: Consolidate your investments, work out your results and prepare your tax information.

data.name: Home_NextStep
data.value: Start by adding an account and, if the platform has an API, its read-only credential.

data.name: NotFound_Message
data.value: The content you are looking for does not exist.

data.name: Accounts_Intro
data.value: One account per platform you trade on. Every movement belongs to exactly one.

data.name: Accounts_Empty
data.value: No accounts yet. Add the first one to start importing movements.

data.name: Accounts_AliasHelp
data.value: To tell it apart from others on the same platform.

data.name: Accounts_DeleteConfirm_Message
data.value: The account will be deleted. If it has imported movements, the operation is refused.

data.name: Credentials_Intro
data.value: Read-only keys so Kapea can download your history. They are kept on the server and never reach the browser.

data.name: Credentials_Empty
data.value: No credentials yet. XTB does not need one: its history is imported from a file.

data.name: Credentials_Warning
data.value: Create the key with read-only permissions. Kapea refuses any that can trade or withdraw funds.

data.name: Credentials_Rotate_Message
data.value: Replaces the key and the secret. The credential history and everything imported with it are kept.

data.name: Credentials_Revoke_Message
data.value: It will no longer be used for synchronisation and its secret is deleted. Movements already imported are kept.

data.name: Credentials_NoApiAccounts
data.value: You need a Kraken or Bit2Me account first. XTB is imported from a file.

data.name: Import_Intro
data.value: Upload the xStation5 export. You will see what would go in before confirming anything.

data.name: Import_NoFileAccounts
data.value: You need an XTB account. Kraken and Bit2Me are imported through their API.

data.name: Import_NothingToImport
data.value: Nothing new to import: everything in the file was already there.

data.name: Imports_Intro
data.value: Every import with what went in, what was discarded as duplicate and what was rejected.

data.name: Imports_Delete_Message
data.value: The import and the movements it created will be deleted. It is refused if any of them is part of a confirmed transfer.

data.name: Review_Intro
data.value: While anything remains here, the portfolio and result figures are incomplete.

data.name: Review_Transfers_Help
data.value: A withdrawal from one account matching a deposit in another. Kapea does not assume it: confirming moves the lots without realising a result, rejecting leaves two independent operations.

data.name: Review_Unclassified_Help
data.value: The source brought a concept that fits no known type. They stay out of the calculation until resolved.

data.name: Portfolio_Intro
data.value: What you hold right now and what it cost. Market value only appears when a price is available.

data.name: Portfolio_Empty
data.value: No open positions. Import movements to see one.

data.name: Portfolio_Incomplete
data.value: These figures are incomplete: there are movements pending review.

data.name: Charts_Empty
data.value: No data to plot for this period.

data.name: Ideas_Intro
data.value: What others propose about an asset, with its date and levels. Tracked to the end so you know what it gave.

data.name: Ideas_PasteHelp
data.value: Paste the text and Kapea will propose the ideas. The text is not stored: only the ideas and the link.

data.name: Ideas_Channel
data.value: Channel, if it can be queried

data.name: Ideas_Unavailable
data.value: No extraction service configured. Ideas are recorded by hand.

data.name: Ideas_NoSource
data.value: Register a source before recording ideas.

data.name: Journal_Intro
data.value: Why you did what you did. Six months from now this is worth more than the signal.

data.name: Journal_Placeholder
data.value: Why you did it, or why you did not.

data.name: Strategies_Intro
data.value: Your rules written down so Kapea evaluates them the same way every time. Kapea does not recommend buying or selling: it applies what you wrote.

data.name: Strategies_DescribeHelp
data.value: Paste the description of the method and Kapea will propose the rules. Review them before saving: whatever it cannot translate it will tell you instead of making it up.

data.name: Strategies_Unavailable
data.value: No translation service configured. Rules are written by hand.

data.name: Strategies_Empty
data.value: No systems yet. Create one to start.

data.name: Signals_Intro
data.value: What your rules say, with the condition that fired. Deciding is still yours.

data.name: Backtest_Intro
data.value: What would have happened applying the system to this asset, with your fees and taxes included.

data.name: Backtest_Loses
data.value: Doing nothing would have been better.

data.name: Backtest_FeeWarning
data.value: At {0} per trade, every buy and sell takes that share before earning anything.

data.name: Performance_Intro
data.value: How you are doing, measured the way a fund is measured, against putting the same money into your largest position.

data.name: Performance_TimeWeighted_Help
data.value: Neutralises when you put money in. This is the one that compares your management with another.

data.name: Performance_MoneyWeighted_Help
data.value: Takes into account when each euro went in. This is what you actually took home.

data.name: Performance_Volatility_Help
data.value: How much your portfolio swings in a year. Higher means bigger scares.

data.name: Performance_Drawdown_Help
data.value: The most you have dropped from an earlier peak.

data.name: Performance_BenchmarkHelp
data.value: What putting the same money, on the same dates, into {0} would have returned.

data.name: Performance_Beating
data.value: Your management is ahead of the reference.

data.name: Performance_Losing
data.value: The reference is ahead of your management.

data.name: Performance_Incomplete
data.value: Some days in the period have no price, so these figures are computed on incomplete data.

data.name: Performance_NoBenchmark
data.value: There is no priced position to compare against.

data.name: Evolution_Intro
data.value: What your portfolio was worth each day. Days without a price are left blank instead of filled in.

data.name: Evolution_Incomplete
data.value: {0} days are missing the price of some asset. Those days fall short.

data.name: Risk_Concentration
data.value: Your {0} largest positions are {1} of the portfolio.

data.name: Portfolio_CashNote
data.value: Cash in other currencies is converted at the rate of the day.

data.name: Portfolio_CashEmpty
data.value: No cash recorded in any account.

data.name: Portfolio_MissingPrices
data.value: Some assets have no price, so the value and the net worth fall short.

data.name: Portfolio_MissingCash
data.value: Cash is unresolved or a currency has no rate, so the net worth falls short.

data.name: Results_Intro
data.value: Capital gains and losses for the tax year, broken down to the lots behind them.

data.name: Results_Empty
data.value: No disposals in this tax year.

data.name: Results_Incomplete
data.value: These figures are incomplete: there are unclassified movements.

data.name: SignIn_Intro
data.value: Kapea stores no passwords. You sign in with an account you already have.

data.name: SignIn_Warning
data.value: Access depends on that account. Once inside, link a second one so losing it does not lock you out.

data.name: SignIn_Failed
data.value: The sign-in could not be completed.

data.name: SignIn_Development
data.value: Development sign-in is on. It only exists in the local environment.

data.name: Session_Expired
data.value: Your session has expired. Sign in again.

data.name: Identities_Heading
data.value: How you sign in to Kapea

data.name: Identities_Intro
data.value: The providers linked to your account. Any of them lets you in.

data.name: Identities_Warning
data.value: With a single provider, losing that account means losing access to your history. Link another one.

data.name: Identities_Unlink_Message
data.value: You will no longer be able to sign in with that provider. Your data is untouched.

data.name: Identities_AppleSoon
data.value: Apple will come later: it requires a paid developer account.

data.name: Platforms_Intro
data.value: The brokers and exchanges you import from. Three come configured; you can add any that exports a file.

data.name: Platforms_Empty
data.value: There are no platforms. That should not happen: the three built-in ones are added at start-up.

data.name: Platforms_CodeHelp
data.value: Letters and digits only, no spaces or accents. It is stored with every imported movement, so it cannot be changed later.

data.name: Platforms_ApiNote
data.value: You can only add file platforms. An API one also needs its own adapter, which is code.

data.name: Platforms_NoProfileYet
data.value: No profile can read its files yet. You will be able to create one once the profiles screen exists.

data.name: Platforms_DeleteConfirm_Message
data.value: If it has accounts, it cannot be retired until you delete them.

data.name: Profiles_Intro
data.value: The recipe for reading each file format: which column is the date, how numbers are written, and what each broker concept means.

data.name: Profiles_Empty
data.value: There are no profiles. The three XTB ones are added automatically at start-up.

data.name: Profiles_EditNote
data.value: Saving creates a new version. The previous one is kept, and movements already imported still point to theirs.

data.name: Profiles_HeadersHelp
data.value: Separated by semicolons. The file may bring more columns; these just need to be present.

data.name: Profiles_DateFormatsHelp
data.value: Separated by semicolons, tried in order. For example dd/MM/yyyy;dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss

data.name: Profiles_FixedCurrency
data.value: Currency, if the file does not bring it

data.name: Profiles_RowShape_OpenPosition
data.value: An open position: the purchase only

data.name: Profiles_RowShape_OpenAndClosePosition
data.value: A closed position: purchase and sale

data.name: Profiles_AmountPositive
data.value: Always store the amount as positive

data.name: Profiles_AmountNetOfFee
data.value: The amount already has the fee deducted

data.name: Profiles_AmountPositiveHelp
data.value: The direction of money is carried by the movement type, so keeping the sign as well would count it twice.

data.name: Profiles_AssetClass
data.value: Asset class, if the whole file is the same

data.name: Profiles_ColumnsHelp
data.value: Leave blank whatever the file does not bring.

data.name: Profiles_ConceptsHelp
data.value: One line per concept: the broker's text, an equals sign, and the type. Anything missing arrives unclassified and shows up in Review.

data.name: Profiles_NonFinancialHelp
data.value: Separated by semicolons. They are counted and discarded, not rejected.

data.name: Profiles_DeleteConfirm_Message
data.value: Movements imported with it do not change, but they will no longer be able to explain the rules they were read with.

data.name: Profiles_BuiltInNote
data.value: It is built in. You can correct it; you cannot delete it, because it would be recreated at the next start-up.

data.name: Import_SampleHelp
data.value: Check that the date, type and amount are what you expect. A wrong mapping produces plausible figures, and this is where you see it.

data.name: Mapping_UnknownHelp
data.value: Kapea does not know how to read this format yet. Create a profile saying which column is which, and from then on it will import it on its own.

data.name: Mapping_WhatIsSent
data.value: What is sent when asking for the proposal

data.name: Mapping_WhatIsSentHelp
data.value: Only the headers and these rows. The rest of the file never leaves your server. The proposal says which column is which; Kapea calculates the amounts.

data.name: Mapping_Proposed
data.value: Proposal applied. Review it before saving.

data.name: Mapping_NeedsReview
data.value: The proposal is not conclusive. Check these points:

data.name: Mapping_NoService
data.value: No proposal service is configured. Map it by hand.

data.name: Review_ReinterpretHelp
data.value: Re-interprets unclassified movements using what Kapea knows today. It asks the platform for nothing and changes no figures.

data.name: Review_Reinterpreted
data.value: {0} movements classified. {1} are still unrecognised and {2} cannot be re-read.

data.name: Review_ReinterpretedNone
data.value: None changed: Kapea does not know what they are either.

data.name: Credentials_SyncAllHelp
data.value: Re-reading the history asks for every movement again from the start. The ones already stored are discarded as duplicates.

data.name: Credentials_SyncHelp
data.value: Automatic synchronisation runs every few hours. This starts it now, useful right after adding a credential.

data.name: Transactions_Intro
data.value: Everything that came in, from wherever. Each one keeps what read it and the original row.

data.name: Transactions_Empty
data.value: None match what you are looking for.

data.name: Home_TodayUnavailable
data.value: Two priced days are needed to compare.

data.name: Home_NoNotices
data.value: Nothing pending and no signals in the last week.

data.name: Import_ManualMatches
data.value: Rows matching movements you entered by hand in this account: {0}. If they are the same, they will count twice: delete the manual entry or discard the import.

data.name: Movement_CorrectHelp
data.value: On saving, the imported movement is voided with this reason and an adjustment with the corrected data is recorded. The import is not deleted: it stays visible, voided.

data.name: Movement_DeleteMessage
data.value: The movement will be deleted and the portfolio and results recalculated.

data.name: Movement_NotePlaceholder
data.value: For example: bought at the branch, paper receipt.

data.name: Movement_PastYear
data.value: The date belongs to tax year {0}. If you already filed it, its results and those of later years may change.

data.name: Movement_ReasonPlaceholder
data.value: Why: without it, nobody will know a year from now.

data.name: Movement_RestoreMessage
data.value: The movement counts again in the portfolio and results, with the same data it had.

data.name: Movement_VoidHelp
data.value: The movement stops counting in the portfolio and results, but it is not deleted: it keeps where it came from and importing again does not bring it back.

data.name: Review_ManualDuplicates_Help
data.value: A movement you entered by hand and an imported one with the same account, type, asset, quantity and day. If they are the same, they count twice.

data.name: Review_ManualDuplicates_DeleteMessage
data.value: The manual movement will be deleted and the imported one kept, since it carries the platform's record.

data.name: Portfolio_Inconsistencies
data.value: Some movements could not be calculated. Until they are, these figures are incomplete:

data.name: Inconsistency_InsufficientLots
data.value: The {0} sale on {1} is missing {2} units: not all of its purchases were found.

data.name: Inconsistency_InsufficientLotsForTransfer
data.value: The {0} transfer on {1} is missing {2} units in the source account.

data.name: Inconsistency_SplitWithoutRatio
data.value: The {0} split on {1} has no ratio, so it was not applied.

data.name: Inconsistency_Unknown
data.value: The {0} movement on {1} could not be calculated.

data.name: Movement_EstimatedHint
data.value: Amount estimated by Kapea from the closing price on {0}. You can correct it.

data.name: Portfolio_ContributedNote
data.value: You have paid in {0} and taken out {1}. Against what you hold today: {2} ({3}).

data.name: Portfolio_ContributedNone
data.value: No deposit on record yet to compare against what you hold.

data.name: Portfolio_ContributedShort
data.value: An asset arrived without its money going through the platform, so the contributed figure falls short and the comparison overstates the loss. A transfer between your own accounts that Kapea never paired up also counts as new money.

data.name: Profiles_SheetHelp
data.value: Name of the workbook sheet this profile reads. Leave it blank if any sheet will do, or if the file has no sheets.

data.name: Watchlist_Intro
data.value: What you follow: what you hold and what you want to watch before holding it. Your systems are evaluated on this list.

data.name: Watchlist_Empty
data.value: You are not following anything yet. Whatever you buy will show up here on its own.

data.name: Watchlist_CannotDrop
data.value: It is in your portfolio: it stays followed while you hold it.

data.name: Watchlist_Already
data.value: That asset was already on your list.

data.name: Watchlist_WithoutPrices
data.value: Added, but no provider has prices for this asset yet. Until that changes it will have no price and no signals.

data.name: Signals_NotHeld
data.value: You do not hold it: nothing to sell

data.name: Signals_TopUp
data.value: You already hold it: this would top up

data.name: Watchlist_NoResults
data.value: Nothing found for that text. You can still follow it by its symbol, choosing what kind of asset it is.

data.name: Watchlist_PartialSearch
data.value: One of the providers did not answer, so results may be missing.
